description: This file manages WiFi applications within a WiFi management framework, including handling events, initializing applications, managing application-specific queues and threads, and updating RFC parameters. It defines functions for event dispatching, application registration, and thread management, indicating it is a core source code component for WiFi application management.

methods.name: wifi_app_t * get_app_by_inst(wifi_apps_mgr_t * apps_mgr,wifi_app_inst_t inst)
methods.description: Retrieves a WiFi application instance from the applications manager based on its identifier.

methods.name: void * app_detached_event_func(void * data)
methods.description: Thread function that waits for app events and processes them by invoking the app's event handler.

methods.name: int push_event_to_app_queue(wifi_app_t * app,wifi_event_t * event)
methods.description: Clones an event and pushes it into the application's event queue, signaling the app thread.

methods.name: int apps_mgr_event(wifi_apps_mgr_t * apps_mgr,wifi_event_t * event)
methods.description: Dispatches an incoming WiFi event to the appropriate applications, handling unicast or broadcast scenarios.

methods.name: int apps_mgr_analytics_event(wifi_apps_mgr_t * apps_mgr,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,void * arg)
methods.description: Creates and dispatches an analytics event to the analytics application instance.

methods.name: int apps_mgr_sm_event(wifi_apps_mgr_t * apps_mgr,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,void * arg)
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a state machine event to the relevant application instance.

methods.name: int apps_mgr_cac_event(wifi_apps_mgr_t * apps_mgr,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,void * arg,int len)
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a CAC (Clear Air Challenge) event if supported.

methods.name: int apps_mgr_link_quality_event(wifi_apps_mgr_t * apps_mgr,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,void * arg,int len)
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a link quality event.

methods.name: int app_deinit(wifi_app_t * app,unsigned int create_flag)
methods.description: Deinitializes an application thread if detached, canceling the thread.

methods.name: int app_init(wifi_app_t * app,unsigned int create_flag)
methods.description: Initializes an application object, setting up mutexes, condition variables, queues, and starting the thread if detached.

methods.name: int update_rfc_params(wifi_app_descriptor_t * descriptor)
methods.description: Updates application descriptor's RFC parameters based on the stored RFC settings.

methods.name: int app_register(wifi_apps_mgr_t * apps_mgr,wifi_app_descriptor_t * descriptor)
methods.description: Registers a new application with the applications manager, initializing its RFC parameters and storing it in the hash map.

methods.name: int apps_mgr_update(wifi_app_t * app)
methods.description: Updates application state via its update function.

methods.name: int apps_mgr_init(wifi_ctrl_t * ctrl,wifi_app_descriptor_t * descriptor,unsigned int num_apps)
methods.description: Initializes the applications manager with a set of application descriptors and allows optional RFC enablement.
